svg.text: every lane starts holding 1; after five halvings lane 0 holds 32. Green = still holds a useful partial sum.
for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) val += __shfl_down_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, val, offset);
Each step halves the lanes that still matter. Data always moves DOWN in lane id, so lane 0 ends with the total.
Lane 16 finishes holding a 16-element partial, not the total. The grey lanes still execute the shuffle; their results are discarded.
Swap in __shfl_xor_sync and every lane ends with 32 instead of just lane 0, for the same five steps.
